about: The record of how each Microsoft Graph permission in the permission manifest (src/shared/services) was checked. test/permission-verification.test.ts fails when the manifest names a permission that is not recorded here.

sources.reference: Microsoft Graph permissions reference on Microsoft Learn (learn.microsoft.com/graph/permissions-reference, dated 2026-09-14): the identifier of each permission as a delegated and as an application permission. A permission with an identifier there is published on Microsoft Graph for that sign-in mode.
sources.model: Microsoft's permission model for Microsoft Graph (github.com/microsoftgraph/microsoft-graph-devx-content, permissions/new/permissions.json, commit 9f88bf8f23a5), from which the permission tables on Microsoft Learn are generated: whether it lists the permission for the endpoint, method and sign-in mode (listed, not listed, or no entry when it does not know the endpoint).
sources.index: The local Microsoft Graph documentation index (msgraph api-docs-search): whether it lists the permission for the endpoint, method and sign-in mode, in the same three words.
sources.live: Read-only requests against the lab tenant with an app-only token on 2026-11-14 (tasks/0.6-research/entra-inventory.md and defender-inventory.md). No write was made, so no restore permission is confirmed live.

statuses.implied: The ReadWrite permission of a Read permission in the same group. Microsoft Graph accepts it wherever it accepts the Read one; it is never the permission TenuVault asks for.
